main.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1 states and provinces, lakes excluded, version 5.1.1, public domain. https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/10m-admin-1-states-provinces/ . Topology-preserving weighted Visvalingam simplification with mapshaper 0.6.121 at 1200x1200 and 300x300, keep-shapes; projected to LAEA, longest side 1000, integer SVG coordinates.
main.projection: Metropolitan France LAEA centered at 46.5 N 3 E; overseas insets use separate local LAEA projections, independently scaled (not common scale).
